name: GenflowAI
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: GenflowAI connects ChatGPT to a multimodal creative-production platform. Users can generate images, videos, audio, and text directly; upload reference media; discover reusable marketplace templates; prepare the required inputs; run published templates or their own saved workflows; and follow each asynchronous run through to its final outputs. GenflowAI is designed for ecommerce product imagery, product videos, UGC-style ads, image-to-video workflows, social content, and repeatable creative production. Generation tools use the authenticated user's existing GenflowAI account, credits, saved workflows, and account-level permissions.
summary_ja: 画像・動画・音声・文章を作り、保存済みの制作ワークフローを実行する。
limitations_ja: 生成には認証済みアカウントとクレジット等を利用。
